What will you do?

As a TIG Welder, you will work closely with a small and experienced team to build high-quality stainless steel filter systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- TIG welding of stainless steel components (RVS/INOX)
- Assembling parts based on technical drawings
- Welding both precision components and larger constructions
- Checking dimensions and product quality
- Contributing ideas for technical improvements and solutions
- Helping build complete filtration systems from start to finish

- Experience as a TIG Welder
- Experience with stainless steel (preferred)
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Good communication skills in English, German, or Dutch
- Eye for detail and quality
- Motivated and reliable attitude

jobs.description:
As a mechanical design engineer, you’ll be indispensable to the engineering team. You’ll be designing, analyzing, and improving mechanical systems. With your dedication, you can earn up to €3,800 per month and can count on a direct contract with the client right away. Want to know if this job is right for you? Then read on!

Your main responsibilities will be: 

    - Designing and optimizing complex mechanical components and rotating systems
    
- Developing technical solutions that prioritize performance, reliability, and manufacturability
    
- Conducting strength and stress analyses to evaluate structures and components 
    
- Selecting suitable materials for applications under high mechanical and thermal loads 
    
- Creating CAD models, technical drawings, and engineering documentation
    
- Collaborating with colleagues from Engineering, Production, and Testing to validate and further optimize designs
    
- Actively contributing to design improvements and the continuous optimization of products and processes

What's in it for you?

    - Gross salary ranging from €3,200 to €3,800 per month
    
- Travel allowance
    
- Full-time position (40 hours per week)
    
- Direct contract with the client

You bring the following experience and knowledge to the role:

    - At least a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a comparable technical field
    
- At least five years of experience as a Mechanical Design Engineer or in a comparable engineering role
    
- Experience designing complex mechanical systems or high-precision rotating components
    
- Knowledge of material properties, tolerances, and design principles for precision structures
    
- Experience with CAD software, such as Siemens NX or SolidWorks
    
- Experience with FEA analyses is a strong plus

In addition, you also possess the following:

    - Proficiency in spoken and written English, as English is the working language within the organization

Perhaps you are currently in a job where every day is the same. Time for something different – ​​variety, modern machinery, and a good salary with a shift allowance!

At Euromouldings in Nijverdal, you work as a production employee in a 5-shift system, which means you not only earn a good salary but also have extra free time. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that plastic bottles and jerrycans are produced and packaged perfectly.

As a production worker at Euromouldings in Nijverdal, you are an important link in the production process. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that the machines keep running and that every product meets quality requirements.

You work in a 5-shift system, which keeps your work varied and gives you plenty of free time. During your shift, you are constantly busy: you maintain an overview, intervene where necessary, and ensure that everything runs neatly and efficiently.

Specifically, what you will be doing:
- You pack plastic bottles and jerrycans in a neat and careful manner
- You check the quality of products and identify deviations
- You measure products using tools such as a caliper
- You assist in keeping the production lines running
- You work together with colleagues to ensure production runs smoothly

In short: you ensure that everything is right — from production to packaging.

Wat zoeken wij
For this position, we are not looking for a perfect CV, but the right attitude. Do you recognize yourself in this?
- You are 18 years or older
- You can work and think at an MBO (intermediate vocational education) level
- You are flexible and have no problem working in a 5-shift system
- You work accurately and have an eye for quality
- You can collaborate well and maintain an overview in a busy environment
- You speak Dutch and/or English

👉 Experience
